title: Manipulating crystallization kinetics and vertical phase distribution via a small molecule donor guest for organic photovoltaic cells with 20% efficiency
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04623D, Paper
Bo Cheng, Wenwen Hou, Chenyu Han, Sixuan Cheng, Xinxin Xia, Xia Guo, Yongfang Li, Maojie Zhang
A kinetics-controlling strategy is used to regulate molecular crystallization and vertical phase distribution, where a third small molecule donor is utilized to advance the aggregation of polymer donor and prolong its self-assembly time.
